description: Would cloudpin allow this shell command, as an agent's? Returns each cloud CLI call in it, the account it would use and why, and the verdict (allow, block or ask) with the reason and the fix. Nothing is run.

command.description: The full command line, e.g. "cd web && vercel deploy --prod".

cwd.description: Folder the command would run in; defaults to the current one.

shell.description: The shell that would run it: powershell for a PowerShell tool's command; defaults to bash.

name: cloudpin_check
